subject_uz: Urganch tumanidagi 9-son maktabgacha ta'lim tashkilotida tarbiyalanuvchilarni autsorsing asosida issiq ovqat bilan ta'minlash (2026-yil noyabr-dekabr)

requirements.summary_en: Service period is 1 November to 31 December 2026.

requirements.summary_uz: Jami 65 nafar tarbiyalanuvchi uchun kuniga 5 mahal ovqatlantirish tashkil etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Meals for 65 children, five meals a day.
requirements.quote: Ovqatlanuvchilar soni va toifalari: Jami: 65 nafar.

requirements.summary_uz: Taomnoma Ijtimoiy himoya milliy agentligining namunaviy taomnomasiga mos bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The menu must follow the Agency's model menu.

requirements.summary_uz: Ustama haq 30 foizdan oshmasligi va 15 foizdan kam bo'lmasligi kerak; shartnoma narxi ustama haq asosida hisoblanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The markup must be between 15% and 30%; the contract price is computed from the winning markup.
requirements.quote: Taklif etiladigan ustama haqi miqdori 30 foizdan oshmasligi hamda 15 foizdan kam bo'lmasligi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Avans oldingi oydagi haqiqiy xarajatning 30 foizi miqdorida to'lanadi, oy yakunida yakuniy hisob-kitob qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Advance is 30% of the previous month's actual cost; final settlement is made monthly.
requirements.quote: 30 foizi miqdorida oldindan to'lov (avans) amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moddiy va kadrlar resurslariga ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, material and staff resources needed to perform the contract.
requirements.quote: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moddiy, kadrlar resurslarining hamda boshqa resurslarning mavjudligi.

requirements.summary_uz: Kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag' bo'lishi va hujjat bilan tasdiqlanishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Working capital of at least three months of the contract value must be shown with documents.
requirements.quote: Autsorsing xizmati bo‘yicha kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag‘larga ega bo‘lish

requirements.summary_uz: Ovqatlantirish bo'yicha tajriba ro'yxati va kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma uchun 15 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 15 points for a list of past catering clients with at least five recommendation letters.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi so‘nggi 3 yil davomida xizmat ko‘rsatgan tashkilotlar ro‘yxatini taqdim etadi (nomi, manzili, xizmat turi, muddati, shartnoma summasi bilan)

requirements.summary_uz: SanQvaN ga mos taomnoma va menyu-kalkulyatsiya uchun 20 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 20 points for a SanQvaN-compliant menu and cost calculation.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi amaldagi SanQvaN talablariga muvofiq taomnoma, menyu-kalkulyatsiya, har bir taom bo‘yicha chiqish vazni

requirements.summary_uz: Oshxona, ombor, sovitkich, transport va xodimlar mavjudligi uchun 20 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 20 points for kitchen equipment, storage, refrigeration, transport and staff.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi autsorsing xizmatini bajarish uchun mavjud moddiy-texnik baza,

requirements.summary_uz: Ruxsat etuvchi hujjatlar va sertifikatlar soniga qarab ball beriladi (20 tadan ortiq - 5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Points depend on the number of permits and certificates (over 20 gives 5 points).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi faoliyat turi uchun talab etiladigan ruxsat etuvchi hujjatlar, sanitariya-epidemiologiya xulosalari, muvofiqlik sertifikatlari, sifat va xavfsizlikni tasdiqlovchi hujjatlarni taqdim etadi

requirements.summary_uz: G'olib shartnoma summasining kamida 1 foizi miqdorida buyurtmachi muassasasiga investitsiya kiritishga roziligini bildiradi (kafolat xati, 5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: The winner must agree to invest at least 1% of the contract value in the institution (guarantee letter, 5 points).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi shartnoma umumiy summasining kamida 1 foizi miqdorida investitsiya kiritishga roziligi haqida kafolat xatini taqdim etadi

requirements.summary_uz: Qish-bahor mavsumida asosiy oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining kamida uch oylik zaxirasini shakllantirish talab etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: The supplier must build a stock of staple foods covering at least three months in winter-spring.
requirements.quote: Qish-bahor mavsumida asosiy turdagi oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining kamida uch oylik zaxirasini shakllantirish

flags.quote: oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining kamida uch oylik zaxirasini
flags.explanation_uz: Shartnoma 2026-yil noyabr-dekabr oylarini, ya'ni ikki oyni qamrab oladi, lekin uch oylik oziq-ovqat zaxirasini yaratish va saqlash talab qilinadi. Bu muddat shartnoma davridan uzoq va katta aylanma mablag' hamda ombor talab qiladi, shuning uchun kichik yetkazib beruvchilar qatnasha olmasligi mumkin. Talabning shartnoma hajmiga mutanosibligini tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.
flags.explanation_en: The contract covers November and December 2026, two months, yet it requires building and keeping a three-month stock of staple food. This exceeds the contract period and needs large working capital and warehouse space, which may keep smaller suppliers out. The proportion to the contract size is worth checking.
flags.rewrite_uz: Autsorser shartnoma muddati davomida ovqatlantirish uzluksizligini ta'minlash uchun zarur hajmdagi oziq-ovqat zaxirasini (kamida bir oylik ehtiyoj miqdorida) saqlaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: The contractor keeps a food stock sufficient for uninterrupted meals during the contract term (at least one month of need).

flags.quote: Autsorsing xizmati bo‘yicha kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag‘larga ega bo‘lish
flags.explanation_uz: Xizmat shartnomasi atigi ikki oyga (noyabr-dekabr) tuzilmoqda, ammo ishtirokchidan kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag' talab qilinadi va bu mezon bo'yicha ball ham beriladi. Bu talab shartnomaning o'zidan ko'proq mablag'ni ko'rsatishni talab qilishi va kichik ijrochilarni chetlashtirishi mumkin. Buyurtmachi bu miqdor shartnoma muddatiga mosligini aniqlashtirishi maqsadga muvofiq.
flags.explanation_en: The contract runs for only two months (November-December), yet bidders must show working capital equal to at least three months of the contract value, and points are scored on it. That is more than the whole contract and may shut out smaller operators. The customer could clarify that the amount matches the contract term.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi shartnoma muddati davomidagi xizmat qiymatini qoplashga yetarli aylanma mablag'lari mavjudligini bank ma'lumotnomasi yoki moliyaviy hisobot bilan tasdiqlaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: The participant confirms, by a bank statement or financial report, that it holds working capital sufficient to cover the service cost for the contract term.

documents_needed_uz: Tanlov qoidalariga rioya etish to'g'risidagi ariza (3-son shakl)
Moddiy-texnik baza va logistika to'g'risida ma'lumot: oshxona jihozlari, ombor, sovitkichlar, transport (5-son shakl)
Moliyaviy imkoniyatlar to'g'risida ma'lumot, bank ma'lumotnomasi (kamida 3 oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag')
Tajriba to'g'risida ma'lumot: so'nggi 3 yilda xizmat ko'rsatilgan tashkilotlar ro'yxati va kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma (7-son shakl)
SanQvaN talablariga mos taomnoma va menyu-kalkulyatsiya (chiqish vazni, tarkibi, mahsulot sarfi)
Ruxsat etuvchi hujjatlar, sanitariya-epidemiologiya xulosalari, muvofiqlik va sifat sertifikatlari
Shartnoma summasining kamida 1 foizi miqdorida investitsiya kiritishga roziligi haqida kafolat xati
Xodimlarning sanitariya kitobchasi va tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tganligini tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar, shtat ro'yxati, diplom va malaka hujjatlari
Soliq qarzdorligi yo'qligi va Majburiy ijro byurosi bazalarida bajarilmagan majburiyatlar yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma

second_pass.note: three kindergarten lots share one template; flags for the same clauses were made consistent across them (added: reserve)
